about: AFL > AFL guernsey (aussie-rules-singlet.glb): the model's own neck band and armhole bands in the Neck trim colour (the look's azure), per triangle: the band pieces sewn on beyond the body's own edges; its inside (the converter's inside bands) one plain colour (MODELQ 2026-11-16, viewer/tripo-parts.mjs). Since MODELQ4 2026-11-17 the colours come from viewer/tripo-pieces.mjs (run after this): the model split into the pieces between its own lines, the bands (neck, armholes) in the Collar colour, everything else the print; its per-triangle parts are then only the lips (printed on both faces).
